judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 20 to the President to cancel the Department of Energy efficiency standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters. The Senate passed it 53-44.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 20 to the President to cancel the Department of Energy efficiency standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters. The Senate passed it 53-44.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S. 146, the TAKE IT DOWN Act, which made it a federal crime to publish intimate images shared without permission, including computer-made deepfakes, and required online platforms to remove them within 48 hours of a valid request. The House passed it 409-2, and it became law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S. 146, the TAKE IT DOWN Act, which made it a federal crime to publish intimate images shared without permission, including computer-made deepfakes, and required online platforms to remove them within 48 hours of a valid request. The House passed it 409-2, and it became law.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 60 to cancel the National Park Service rule limiting off-road vehicle use in parts of the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area around Lake Powell. The House passed it 219-205.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 60 to cancel the National Park Service rule limiting off-road vehicle use in parts of the Glen Canyon National Recreation Area around Lake Powell. The House passed it 219-205.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 87, which revoked the Clean Air Act permissions letting California enforce its own heavy-duty vehicle emission warranty rules and its Advanced Clean Trucks and zero-emission fleet standards. The House passed it 231-191.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 87, which revoked the Clean Air Act permissions letting California enforce its own heavy-duty vehicle emission warranty rules and its Advanced Clean Trucks and zero-emission fleet standards. The House passed it 231-191.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 89, which revoked the federal permission for California's low-nitrogen-oxide pollution rules for heavy-duty on-road and off-road diesel engines. The House passed it 225-196.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 89, which revoked the federal permission for California's low-nitrogen-oxide pollution rules for heavy-duty on-road and off-road diesel engines. The House passed it 225-196.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 42 to the President to cancel the Department of Energy rule tightening certification, labeling, and enforcement requirements behind appliance energy-efficiency standards. The Senate passed it 52-46.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 42 to the President to cancel the Department of Energy rule tightening certification, labeling, and enforcement requirements behind appliance energy-efficiency standards. The Senate passed it 52-46.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 49, which would end the April 2, 2025 emergency used to place a 10 percent tariff on most imports and higher tariffs on some trading partners. The Senate tied 49-49, so it did not become law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 49, which would end the April 2, 2025 emergency used to place a 10 percent tariff on most imports and higher tariffs on some trading partners. The Senate tied 49-49, so it did not become law.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 78 to cancel the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service rule listing the San Francisco Bay-Delta longfin smelt as endangered, removing the fish's Endangered Species Act protection. The House passed it 216-195.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 78 to cancel the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service rule listing the San Francisco Bay-Delta longfin smelt as endangered, removing the fish's Endangered Species Act protection. The House passed it 216-195.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.J.Res. 88, which revoked the Clean Air Act permission letting California enforce its Advanced Clean Cars II rules requiring rising shares of low-emission and zero-emission new cars. The House passed it 246-164.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.J.Res. 88, which revoked the Clean Air Act permission letting California enforce its Advanced Clean Cars II rules requiring rising shares of low-emission and zero-emission new cars. The House passed it 246-164.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 75 to the President to cancel the Department of Energy efficiency standards for commercial refrigerators, freezers, and refrigerator-freezers. The Senate passed it 52-45.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 75 to the President to cancel the Department of Energy efficiency standards for commercial refrigerators, freezers, and refrigerator-freezers. The Senate passed it 52-45.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 31 to cancel the federal environmental agency rule requiring plants that lower their federal pollution category to keep controlling dangerous air pollutants that last and build up in living things. The Senate passed it 52-46.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 31 to cancel the federal environmental agency rule requiring plants that lower their federal pollution category to keep controlling dangerous air pollutants that last and build up in living things. The Senate passed it 52-46.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for sending H.J.Res. 61 to the President to cancel the federal environmental agency emission standards for hazardous air pollutants released by rubber tire manufacturing plants. The Senate passed it 55-45.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 61 to the President to cancel the federal environmental agency emission standards for hazardous air pollutants released by rubber tire manufacturing plants. The Senate passed it 55-45.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 13 to cancel the federal bank rule ending fast automatic approval and short-form applications for mergers. The Senate passed it 52-47.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against S.J.Res. 13 to cancel the federal bank rule ending fast automatic approval and short-form applications for mergers. The Senate passed it 52-47.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for S.J.Res. 7 to cancel the federal communications agency rule letting schools and libraries use federal internet discounts to lend Wi-Fi hotspots to students and patrons without home internet. The Senate passed it 50-38.

judgments.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 2243, the LEOSA Reform Act of 2025, which let qualified active and retired law enforcement officers carry concealed firearms in school zones, national parks, public property, and certain federal buildings open to the public. The House passed it 229-193.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 2243, the LEOSA Reform Act of 2025, which let qualified active and retired law enforcement officers carry concealed firearms in school zones, national parks, public property, and certain federal buildings open to the public. The House passed it 229-193.
